description: This file defines configuration parsing logic for a TalkProvider, including structures for configuration selection, methods for bridging Foundation dictionaries, resolving provider configs, and handling timeouts.

classes.name: TalkProviderConfigSelection
classes.description: Structure representing the configuration selection for a talk provider, including provider name, config dictionary, and payload normalization flag.

methods.name: bridgeFoundationDictionary
methods.description: Converts a Foundation dictionary with Any values into a dictionary with AnyCodable values.

methods.name: selectProviderConfig
methods.description: Selects the appropriate provider configuration from a dictionary, with support for default provider fallback and legacy fallback options.

methods.name: resolvedPositiveInt
methods.description: Resolves an AnyCodable value to a positive integer, with fallback.

methods.name: resolvedSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Resolves the silence timeout in milliseconds, with fallback.

methods.name: normalizedTalkProviderID
methods.description: Normalizes and trims a provider ID string.

methods.name: resolvedProviderConfig
methods.description: Resolves the provider configuration from a dictionary, returning a TalkProviderConfigSelection if valid.
